01
Head coach

Led by Hannah.

Head coach Hannah Guthrie runs the club — and she’s the person to talk to about joining, training, or bringing your team along.

HANNAH GUTHRIEHead coach · Timaru

“Come along, have a go — you’ll be surprised what you can do.”

Timaru Boxing Association trains on Craigie Ave, in the heart of Timaru. Sessions run Monday and Wednesday nights, with a women’s boxing fitness class on Thursdays.

It’s a club for everyone: young boxers learning the ropes, adults getting fit, and fighters preparing for the ring. No experience needed — just turn up, and the team will look after you.

To join, or to ask about a session, email Hannah directly — she’ll get you started.

02
Women’s boxing

Boxing fitness for women.

Thursdays, 6–7pm, is women’s boxing fitness — an hour of pads, bags and movement that’s as fun as it is fit. Bring a friend, or come on your own and meet the group.

It runs as a $50 four-week block, so you’re training with the same group week to week — and watching each other improve.

No experience, no gear, no worries. Just comfortable clothes and a drink bottle.
